Ret & Ben::CC2.formula: IF(AND(BT2=BW2, BU2=BY2, BV2=0), 0, IF(AND(BT2=BX2, BU2=BZ2, BV2=CA2), 1, 2))

Ret & Ben::CJ2.formula: IF(OR(BT2="2", BC2>0),1,ROUND(BFCFAEQ("SLA",0,0,0,"JSN",0.6667,120,0,IF(BC2="", anb(K2, BJ2), CD2),IF(BC2="", anb(X2, BJ2), CE2),M2,IF(M2="F","M","F"),AEQ_Int,AEQ_Mort,AEQ_Mort,"MP","N",N2), 4))

Separated & Active Vesteds::EX2.formula: IF(OR(EM2="0",EM2="9"),CONCATENATE("Joint-and-",EQ2*100,"% Survivor Annuity",IF(EM2="0"," with Pop-up","")),IF(OR(EM2="5", EM2=5),CONCATENATE(ROUND(EU2/12,4),"-Year Certain-and-Continuous Annuity"),IF(EM2="A",CONCATENATE("Joint-and-",EQ2*100,"% Survivor Annuity with 120 Months Certain"),"Straight Life Annuity")))

Separated & Active Vesteds::FW2.formula: IF(AND(EM2=EF2, ER2=EU2),IF(F2="1", 1, FL2),IF(AND(M2>0,M2>DOPT,H2="R"),FL2, IF(AND(G2="DOR",OR(FN2="OSF", FN2="OMF")), FV2,FK2)))

Separated & Active Vesteds::FX2.formula: IF(AND(G2="DOR", EB2<DOTR), AS2, IF(F2="2",ROUND(DH2*FH2*FJ2*FL2*QPSAPercent,2), ROUND(DH2*FH2*FJ2*IF(AND(M2>DOPT, M2<EB2), FL2, FW2),2)))
